'''1999 Decipher World Championship Markus Wuest DS''' is a [[Dark]] deck by [[Markus Wuest]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ds94.htm Wuest Hunt Down], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050519045401/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ds94.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
